meta.title: 曲线RGB三原色互补与混合原理
meta.title_en: Curves: RGB Complementary and Mixing Principles
meta.topic: PS 调色 · 曲线互补与混合原理

scenes.context: RGB 三色叠加变白代表亮暗，两两混合出青黄品红三补色。
sentences: 红绿蓝三种颜色叠加会变成白色。
Red, green, and blue stacked together become white.
stack（叠加）
在 PS 里会当做亮暗来处理。
In Photoshop it's treated as brightness.
brightness（亮度）
红色的对立色就是青色。
The opposite of red is cyan.
opposite（对立色）
paraphrase: All three channels at full strength give you white.
Each primary has a complement that cancels it.
scenes.speak: Red, green, and blue stacked together become white. In Photoshop it's treated as brightness. The opposite of red is cyan.

scenes.title_en: Complementary Method: Add Blue, Cut Yellow
scenes.context: 皮肤偏黄要剪黄，蓝黄互补，提蓝曲线就抵消了黄色。
sentences: 人物的肤色特别的黄。
The skin tone looks very yellow.
skin tone（肤色）
蓝和黄是互补色，蓝多黄就少。
Blue and yellow are complementary — more blue means less yellow.
complementary（互补的）
选蓝色往上一提，黄就被抵消了。
Lift the blue curve and the yellow cancels out.
cancel out（抵消）
paraphrase: Adding its opposite color neutralizes the cast.
scenes.speak: The skin tone looks very yellow. Blue and yellow are complementary — more blue means less yellow. Lift the blue curve and the yellow cancels out.

scenes.title_en: Mixing Method: Reduce Red and Green
scenes.context: 黄色由红绿混合，减红减绿让蓝主导；但曲线下压会变暗，需回 RGB 提亮。
sentences: 黄色是由红色和绿色叠加混合成的。
Yellow is made by mixing red and green.
mix（混合）
把红色减去、绿色减去。
Reduce the red and reduce the green.
reduce（减去）
回到 RGB 把它提亮。
Go back to RGB and brighten it up.
brighten（提亮）
paraphrase: Make blue the dominant color to kill the yellow.
Pushing the curve down darkens the image.
scenes.speak: Yellow is made by mixing red and green. Reduce the red and reduce the green. Go back to RGB and brighten it up.

scenes.context: 曲线上提变亮下压变暗；RGB 只调亮暗；要配合其他工具才能调好照片。
sentences: 曲线往上提，画面变亮。
Pull the curve up and the image brightens.
curve（曲线）
曲线往下压，画面变暗。
Push it down and the image darkens.
darken（变暗）
光靠曲线没法完成所有工作。
The curve alone can't do all the work.
can't do all the work（无法完成所有）
paraphrase: The RGB channel only controls brightness.
Pair curves with other tools for a full grade.
scenes.speak: Pull the curve up and the image brightens. Push it down and the image darkens. The curve alone can't do all the work.

practice: RGB 三色叠加变成什么？
They become white, which the curve treats as brightness.
Yellow — add blue to cut yellow.
Reduce red and green so blue becomes dominant.
pitfalls: 用 RGB 曲线改颜色
RGB 只调亮暗，不改色相。
下压变暗会损失通透感。
